visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 current portable views, including the retained 1024×640 summary. A continuous polygonal horseshoe cliff has layered basalt faces, a variable rock cap, a connecting ledge, recessed pillared porticos, two estimated double-height galleries and four larger arched chaitya fronts (9/10/19/26). Coarse cornices, jambs, columns, arch moldings and sparse frieze blocks abstract the exterior without reproducing historic artwork. The sharp bend at cave16 initially left green slits beside the recess; jambs and ceilings now meet the actual angled cliff panels. Current renders and edge probes confirm the correction. Both cliff ends are closed. Recesses have shallow closed back walls, floors and ceilings; they are not reconstructed navigable cave interiors.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected 11 current shared-material/geographic views. Three existing shared256² graphs—raw basalt, plain concrete and painted metal—serve five semantic roles merged into four near materials. Metric UVs and linear tints; no embedded images, photo textures or unique atlas. The actual viewer reads each graph once, places the current model with the retained heading and rebased terrain reference, opens the occupied narrow cliff ribbon, and restores terrain/disposes geometry on unload. Flat placement views show approximate pose and cutout operation; they do not establish surveyed cliff geometry. No building footprint replacement is enabled; all four independent mapped neighboring buildings remain.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all 27 current medium-fi views: Economy/High, noon/late light, street/block/skyline, silhouette, six details, four matched LODs and four transitions. Every level retains the horseshoe cliff and entrance rhythm. Skyline uses deliberately opaque recess and arch fields; district adds open recesses, square columns and simple chaitya surrounds; street/closeup add shaped columns, carved bands, sparse relief and arched-window framing. Coarse faceted rock and estimated proportions are intentional exterior abstractions. The standard DEM fixture remains approximate and synthetic surrounding context is illustrative. Physical laptop/phone/tablet and full-city timing remain pending.

fidelityReview.notes: Ajanta Caves main horseshoe-cliff exterior,with28 numbered frontage reconstructions:23 current map-controlled entrances,three interpolated gaps and two estimated endpoints. Includes open recessed porticos,selected double-height galleries,picture-guided chaitya facades9/10/19/26 with large arched windows and door groups,a connecting ledge and layered basalt rock shell. The archaeological boundary is retained only as evidence. Upper excavations29/30,fine sculpture,paintings,deep/navigable interiors,trees,river,bridges,modern visitor buildings and engineering are excluded. No architectural height facts or entrance elevations are supplied. Raw standard DEM heights at the23 mapped and five inferred frontage positions are retained. The review ledge uses their median plus15 percent of local deviation to avoid treating the coarse sloping DEM as surveyed cave thresholds. Cliff bottoms extend to sampled valley-side grade or10 m below the ledge;tops meet sampled rear grade or18 m above the ledge. Cave widths,depths,opening heights,chaitya proportions,upper galleries and rock strata are original picture-guided estimates. Unverified upper excavations29/30,exact sculptures,paintings and interiors are not reconstructed. The model reconstructs28 main-frontage positions:23 map-controlled, three interpolated gaps and two estimated endpoints. Upper incomplete/unverified excavations29/30 are omitted. Rock strata, ledge level, widths, depths, facing, architectural subdivisions and present condition remain estimates. Fine sculpture, paintings, historic inscriptions, deep interiors, river, vegetation, visitor facilities, surveyed grades and engineering are not supplied. This is an original medium-fi exterior visualization, not a surveyed complete site reconstruction.
